=== Day 2: the town meeting ===
Odette: "I have a perfectly good reason to suspect Nisha, which I shall share when it suits me."  [case board: #46]
Nisha: "To eliminate an unnecessary unknown from the town's reasoning: I am the Warden."
Nisha: "Odette raises a serious flag on the board. Bartholomew's reading says the people living on the Square aren't all on one side, and they live there."  [case board: #47, #48]
Odette: "Since we are doing public confessions today, let's get mine over with: I am the Night Watch."
Odette: "The night before you arrived, I watched the Docks: nobody stirred."
Odette: "Last night, I watched the Square: I saw Constance and Nisha pass by."  [case board: #49, #50, #51]
Constance: "I must voice my misgivings regarding Merrin; their conduct troubles me."  [case board: #52]
Merrin: "Beware Constance, good neighbors, before it's too late! Odette saw them out at night where someone was killed."  [case board: #53]
Hollis: "So that the record is free of ambiguity on this point: I am the Martyr."
Hollis: "Last night, I have given my life over for Constance, should the town ever hang them."
Hollis: "I concur with Constance's assessment of Merrin. I saw them out in the street from my window last night."  [case board: #54, #55, #56, #57]
Fenwick: "Friends and neighbors, the hour calls for a grand unveiling! I am the Dowser!"
Fenwick: "On day 1, in the morning, on the Square I sensed 1 evil among Nisha, Hollis, Odette, Bartholomew."
Fenwick: "This morning, on the Square I sensed 0 evil among Odette and Bartholomew."
Fenwick: "Score one for Merrin—I too have my eye on Constance!"  [case board: #58, #59, #60, #61]
Bartholomew: "Don't trust Lian. Something's off there."  [case board: #28]
Lian: "Here's what the town needs to know to narrow the list: I am the Psychologist."
Lian: "Last night, I learned that at least one of these two statements from day 1 was a lie or misreading: Bartholomew's Surveyor reading (the night before you arrived); or Merrin's Rumormonger reading (the night before you arrived)."  [case board: #62, #63, #27, #23]

=== Day 3: the town meeting ===
Odette: "Before you invent a grander theory: Last night, I watched the Square: I saw Hollis and Nisha pass by."  [case board: #84]
Hollis: "I am compelled to question Merrin's standing. I saw them out in the street from my window last night."  [case board: #85, #57]
Merrin: "Beware Hollis, good neighbors, before it's too late! Odette saw them out at night where someone was killed."  [case board: #86]
Fenwick: "Before the curtain rises, a word: This afternoon, on the Docks I sensed 2 evil among Hollis, Lian, Greta."
Fenwick: "Score one for Merrin—I too have my eye on Hollis! My own reading on the Docks found 2 evil souls in a crowd that included them."  [case board: #87, #88]
Greta: "I'll put my cards on the table so the rest of you stop squinting at me: I am the Gravedigger."
Greta: "Last night, I learned that Constance, whom we hanged, was the Demon."
Greta: "From my window, I saw Odette out in the street the night before you arrived."  [case board: #89, #90, #91]
Lian: "Before we waste time: Last night, I learned that at least one of these two statements from day 2 was a lie or misreading: Odette's Night Watch reading (the night before you arrived); or Fenwick's Dowser reading (night 2)."  [case board: #92, #50, #60]
